arxiv-2201-02441.description: Abstract 1 Introduction Anomaly detection (or outlier detection) is defined as the task of detecting abnormal instances, which are the rare items, events or observations deviating significantly from the majority of the data. While these instances are called outliers (anomalies), the normal instances are called inliers.

arxiv-2212-01101.title: Assessing Anonymized System Logs Usefulness for Behavioral Analysis in RNN Models
arxiv-2212-01101.creator: Tom Richard Vargis, Siavash Ghiasvand
arxiv-2212-01101.description: Abstract System logs are a common source of monitoring data for analyzing computing systems behavior. Due to the complexity of modern computing systems and the large size of collected monitoring data, automated analysis mechanisms are required. Numerous machine learning and deep learning methods are proposed to address this challenge.

arxiv-2212-06395.title: Microscopic expression of anomalous dissipation in Passive scalar transport
arxiv-2212-06395.creator: Tomonori Tsuruhashi, Tsuyoshi Yoneda
arxiv-2212-06395.description: Abstract . We study anomalous dissipation from a microscopic viewpoint. In the work by Drivas, Elgindi, Iyer and Jeong (2022), the property of anomalous dissipation provides the existence of non-unique weak solutions for a transport equation with a singular velocity field. In this paper, we reconsider this solution in terms of kinetic theory and clarify its microscopic property.

arxiv-2403-14561.creator: Xinyue Chen, Vitaliy Popov, Jingying Wang, Michael Kemp, Gurjit Sandhu, Taylor Kantor, Natalie Mateju, Xu Wang
arxiv-2403-14561.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xinyue Chen, Vitaliy Popov, Jingying Wang, Michael Kemp, Gurjit Sandhu, Taylor Kantor, Natalie Mateju, Xu Wang. Shared gaze visualizations have been found to enhance collaboration and communication outcomes in diverse HCI scenarios including computer supported collaborative work and learning contexts. Given the importance of gaze in surgery operations, especially when a surgeon trainer and trainee need to coordinate their actions, research on the use of gaze to facilitate intra-operative coordination and instruction has been limited and shows mixed implications.

arxiv-2412-06999.title: Influence of the turbulent magnetic pressure on isothermal jet emitting disks
arxiv-2412-06999.creator: N. Zimniak, J. Ferreira, J. Jacquemin-Ide
arxiv-2412-06999.description: Abstract Context. The theory of jet emitting disks (JEDs) provides a mathematical framework for a self-consistent treatment of steady-state accretion and ejection. A large-scale vertical magnetic field threads the accretion disk where magnetic turbulence occurs in a strongly magnetized plasma. A fraction of mass leaves the disk and feeds the two laminar super-Alfvénic jets.

arxiv-2602-09450.title: Orthogonal Circular Polarized Transmitter and Receiver Antennas for Mitigation of Mutual Coupling in Monostatic Radars
arxiv-2602-09450.creator: Shobha Sundar Ram, Akanksha Sneh
arxiv-2602-09450.description: Abstract Through-wall radar systems require compact, wideband and high gain antennas for detecting targets. Building walls introduce considerable attenuation on the radar signals. When the transmitted power is raised to compensate the through-wall attenuation, the direct coupling between the transmitter and receiver can saturate the receiver because of which weaker reflections off the target may remain undetected.

pmc-11655180.title: Synthesis of β‐Alanine From Isoleucine and Propionate Catabolism via Aminotransferases
pmc-11655180.creator: Margo H. Goldfarb, Joseph Boesel, Kai C. Wilczewski‐Shirai, Peter Reinhart, Trenton Scherger, Chloe Webb, Morgan Newlun, Kerry A. Rouhier
pmc-11655180.description: In plants, the nonproteinogenic amino acid β‐alanine plays a role in response to hypoxia, flooding, drought, heat, and heavy metal stress conditions. It is also a key intermediate in the synthesis of essential molecules including vitamin B5 and coenzyme A (CoA) through the condensation reaction with pantoate.

pmc-11663761.title: Annotation-free multi-organ anomaly detection in abdominal CT using free-text radiology reports: a multi-centre retrospective study
pmc-11663761.creator: Junya Sato, Kento Sugimoto, Yuki Suzuki, Tomohiro Wataya, Kosuke Kita, Daiki Nishigaki, Miyuki Tomiyama, Yu Hiraoka, Masatoshi Hori, Toshihiro Takeda, Shoji Kido, Noriyuki Tomiyama
pmc-11663761.description: SummaryBackgroundArtificial intelligence (AI) systems designed to detect abnormalities in abdominal computed tomography (CT) could reduce radiologists’ workload and improve diagnostic processes. However, development of such models has been hampered by the shortage of large expert-annotated datasets. Here, we used information from free-text radiology reports, rather than manual annotations, to develop a deep-learning-based pipeline for comprehensive detection of abdominal CT abnormalities.

pmc-12605519.title: Clinical outcomes and safety of CD47-targeted immunotherapies across hematologic malignancies: a systematic review of monoclonal antibodies and fusion proteins in combination strategies
pmc-12605519.creator: Wajahat Mirza, Sundas Dadan, Eshan Ahmad, Ayesha Junaid, Tariq Mahmood Satti
pmc-12605519.description: BackgroundThe CD47-SIRPα axis is a key innate immune checkpoint that enables tumor cells to evade macrophage-mediated clearance. CD47 is overexpressed in a spectrum of hematologic malignancies, contributing to poor outcomes, particularly in high-risk biological subgroups. While early clinical trials of CD47 blockade demonstrated limited efficacy as monotherapy, combination strategies have emerged as promising approaches.

pmc-12608310.title: A Novel Strategy for Introducing Metal-Organic Frameworks into Carbon Fiber to Improve the Interfacial and Mechanical Properties of Carbon Fiber/Epoxy Composites
pmc-12608310.creator: Jin Yan, Hongyi Ma, Qiyu Deng, Hongyun Li, Lei Xiong, Ricardo J C Carbas
pmc-12608310.description: The interfacial properties in carbon fiber (CF)-reinforced polymer composites are substantially limited by the chemically inactive and smooth CF surfaces. In this study, zeolitic imidazolate framework 90 (ZIF90) was chemically grafted onto CF surfaces via polyethyleneimine (PEI) as a coupling agent to construct a hierarchical reinforcement interface in CF/epoxy composite.

pmc-12641564.title: Serous maculopathy in congenital cavitary optic disc anomaly: A case series
pmc-12641564.creator: Jenna Krivit, Gregor S Reiter, Run Zhou Ye, Kahlen Darr, Lisa A Schimmenti, Raymond Iezzi
pmc-12641564.description: PurposeThis study aims to describe an adult child and parent with cavitary optic disc anomalies (CODA) with associated serous maculopathy and a non-coding triplication upstream of MMP19.DesignRetrospective, single-institution, observational case series.Subjects4 eyes of 2 related patients.MethodsThis retrospective chart review used electronic medical records to summarize patient medical history, ophthalmology consultations, whole genome analysis, and imaging.

pmc-12655033.title: Nutritional Determinants of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus in the European Union: A Systematic Review
pmc-12655033.creator: Daniela Alejandra Díaz-Benavides, Abdu Nafan Aisul Muhlis, Ghenwa Chamouni, Rita Charles, Digafe Tsegaye Nigatu, Jomana Ben Khadra, Frederico Epalanga Albano Israel, Bashar Shehab, Gabriella Laila Tarek, Aidai Sharshekeeva, Nasser Gammoh, Tulu Tefera Habte, Niyati Chandrika, F K Alshakhshir, Nour Ma
pmc-12655033.description: Background/Objectives: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) represents a growing public health burden in the European Union (EU), largely driven by modifiable lifestyle factors such as diet. This systematic review aimed to synthesize observational evidence on the associations between nutritional exposures and incident T2DM across the EU-28, with a focus on regional heterogeneity and implications for EU-level nutrition policy.

pmc-12963019.title: Perspective: The Future of the Southern Resident Killer Whales Depends on Interactions With Other Killer Whale Populations
pmc-12963019.creator: Michael J Ford, Eric J Ward, Marty Kardos, Kim M Parsons, Candice Emmons, M Bradley Hanson
pmc-12963019.description: Ecological and genetic interactions among conspecific populations play an important role in population viability, but these interactions are not always fully considered in strategies to recover endangered taxa. Southern Resident killer whales are a high‐profile population listed as endangered by both the United States and Canada.
